name: Leading the Future
summary: A pro-AI-industry super PAC network launched in August 2025 with more than $140 million from Andreessen Horowitz, OpenAI president Greg Brockman, Joe Lonsdale and others, modeled on the crypto super PAC Fairshake. It backs candidates in both parties who favor light AI regulation and spent $8.16 million against New York Democrat Alex Bores; an affiliated dark-money group, Build American AI, runs issue campaigns. By late October 2026 it had spent about $35 million.

sources.title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman and Andreessen Horowitz back AI super PAC — Fortune
